svg.title: The evidence gate
svg.desc: A test walks every registered visualization, and a trace step with no source that resolves fails the suite. Steps: 1. A test walks every registered visualization. 2. Each trace step must name a source. 3. Each cited key must resolve in sources.js. 4. A step with no source fails the build. Sources: Algorithm Visualizer README.

text.tspan: A test walks every registered visualization.
Each trace step must name a source.
Each cited key must resolve in sources.js.
A step with no source fails the build.
